decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
1.	The proposed portable cabin, by way of its design and appearance, does not have due regard for the architectural detailing of the adjacent Manor House and will be visually incongruous and out of character with the dynamics of the associated conservation area, which is contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed portable cabin would, by reason of its location, reduce the availability of on site car parking resulting in an over spill of vehicles on to the neighbouring streets, which would be detrimental to the traffic related amenity of the area and is contrary to Adopted UDP policies T.1.4 (Car Parking Facilities) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
description: Erection of a temporary portable cabin to the front of the car park of Health Centre
